_comment: Grounded junctions J1 (node 1), J2 (node 2) with EJ = E_Jk, and a coupling capacitor Cc between nodes 1 and 2; Z_full = identity, all modes c.

Element capacitances C = ghz_to_farad(x) with x_1 = D/(E_C2 - g/8), x_2 = D/(E_C1 - g/8), x_c = 8 D/g, D = E_C1 E_C2 - g^2/64: the values whose inverse capacitance matrix is [[E_C1, g/8], [g/8, E_C2]] (see transmons() in generate_specs.py).
The capacitive loop J1-Cc-J2 carries zero flux (Loops.from_circuit with zero_capacitive=True).
Sector labels n_g1, n_g2 already carry the fixture's names.
